content: Hanʉ gayo gaahitirɨ, nɨkarora maraika ʉwʉndɨ wʉ ʉbhʉnaja ariika kurwa mwisaarʉ. Maraika wuyo aarɨ iruguutiriirwɨ na amasaarʉ, ni igʉrʉ wu umutwɨ ryareho ritabhaasi ryi imbura. Ubhushʉ bhwazɨ bhwarɨ bhʉrabharya nchi iryʉbha, na amagʉrʉ gaazɨ gaarɨ ncha amarʉmbɨrʉ ganʉ gaakirɨ omorero.
Aarɨ anɨ ɨkɨtabhʉ ikisuuhu mokobhoko, kɨnʉ charɨ chigwirwɨ. Akiimɨɨrɨra ʉkʉgʉrʉ ku ubhuryʉ igʉrʉ wɨ ɨnyanza na kwʉ ʉbhʉmʉsi kʉʉsɨ ɨnyʉmu.
Akabhɨrɨkɨra kwiraka ncha ryɨ ɨɨka yɨnʉ ikuruma. Hanʉ maraika aabhirikiirɨ, ikirumo kɨkagarukirya kuruma manga muhungatɨ.
Hanʉ ibhirumo muhungatɨ bhiyo bhyarumirɨ, naarɨ nereenda kwandɨka ganʉ gaagambirwɨ ni ikirumo. Nawe nikiigwa riraka kurwa mwisaarʉ rɨrabhuga, “Amangʼana gi ikirumo gayo ʉtagaandɨka! Ni mbisi.”
Akʉmara maraika wʉnʉ aarɨ imiiriirɨ ʉkʉgʉrʉ kʉmwɨ igʉrʉ wɨ ɨnyanza nʉ ʉkʉndɨ kʉʉsɨ ɨnyʉmu, akagorora okobhoko kwazɨ ku ubhuryʉ kwisaarʉ.
Akiirahɨra kuriina rya Mungu wʉnʉ akwikara kemerano, wʉnʉ aatɨɨmirɨ mwisaarʉ, kʉʉsɨ, mʉnyanza ni ibhityɨnyi bhyʉsi bhɨnʉ bhirimu. Akabhuga, “Ribhaga ryʉ ʉkʉrɨnda risirirɨ.
Hanʉ maraika wa muhungatɨ araateme rihembe ryazɨ, Mungu aramara amangʼana gaazɨ gi imbisi. Garamarwa chɨmbu aabharwaziirɨ abhahocha bhaazɨ abharʉʉtɨrɨri.”

Neho riraka rirya kurwa mwisaarʉ rɨkambɨrɨkɨra kwikɨ, rɨkabhuga, “Nuujɨ kwa maraika wʉnʉ imiiriirɨ kʉgʉrʉ kʉmwɨ igʉrʉ wɨ ɨnyanza nʉ ʉkʉndɨ kʉʉsɨ ɨnyʉmu, ogegege mʉmabhoko gaazɨ ɨkɨtabhʉ ikisuuhu kirya, chahumbwirwɨ.”
Mmbe nɨkamujaku, nɨkamʉsabha angʼɨ ɨkɨtabhʉ ikisuuhu kirya, wʉʉsi akabhuga, “Nkɨnʉ hanʉ! Kegege ukiryɨ. Kumunywa gwazʉ kɨrabha kɨrazomeerera nchu ubhwʉkɨ, nawe kɨrakokorera ʉbhʉsʉngʉ mʉnda yaazʉ.”
Nɨkagega ɨkɨtabhʉ ikisuuhu kirya kurwa mokobhoko kwa maraika wuyo, nɨkarya. Charɨ kɨrazomeerera nchu ubhwʉkɨ mumunywa gwanɨ, nawe hanʉ nakimirirɨ, nikiigwa ʉbhʉsʉngʉ.
Nɨkabhuurirwa, “Oreenderwa korootorera kwikɨ kwa bhamaraika bhaaru, zɨɨsɨ nzaru, ɨbhɨgambʉ bhyaru ni igʉrʉ wa abhatɨmi bhaaru.”
